raw:
@q query
  where match
    relation "approve"
    role subject "Farida and Chen"
    role object "the Q4 hardware budget"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?m
  where all
    match
      relation "approve"
      role subject "Farida"
      role object "the Q4 hardware budget"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "approve"
      role subject "Chen"
      role object "the Q4 hardware budget"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
